name: help-center-builder
description: Turn a folder of Markdown / HTML docs into a static help center: home page with category cards, category pages, articles with breadcrumbs, sidebar, table of contents, related articles and previous / next, and instant full-text search that works offline (Chinese too). Incremental builds rewrite only the pages a change affects and list them with the reason. Broken links and anchors are reported. The output folder can be uploaded to any static host.

description_i18n.en: Turn a folder of Markdown / HTML docs into a static help center: home page with category cards, category pages, articles with breadcrumbs, sidebar, table of contents, related articles and previous / next, and instant full-text search that works offline (Chinese too). Incremental builds rewrite only the pages a change affects and list them with the reason. Broken links and anchors are reported. The output folder can be uploaded to any static host.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一个放 Markdown / HTML 文档的文件夹生成静态帮助中心：带分类卡片的首页、分类页，文章页有面包屑、侧边导航、目录、相关文章和上一篇 / 下一篇，还有离线可用的即时全文搜索（支持中文）。增量构建只重写受改动影响的页面，并列出原因；同时报告坏链和失效锚点。输出文件夹可直接上传到任意静态托管。
